episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When an elite assassin carries out his latest kill, it catches the attention of an intelligence officer, who starts to hunt him down.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: With his previous client backing out of payment, the Jackal's reputation is on the line and he starts to plot his revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Armed with the knowledge of his wayward client's identity, the Jackal tracks him down in Munich, determined to settle the score.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: His vengeance fulfilled, the Jackal flees Munich and tries to quell Nuria's suspicions. Bianca follows a new lead in her hunt.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The Jackal visits Norman with a special commission... but with Bianca also tracking Norman down, she is starting to close in on him.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Following his shootout with Bianca, the Jackal must escape his captors and regroup ahead of his next hit, as Bianca follows his trail.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The Jackal and Bianca both descend on Tallinn in anticipation of UDC's announcement; with the venue in lockdown and Bianca closing in, the Jackal must use all his wiles as he prepares to take his shot.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Bianca gains insight into a secret file. She learns the true identity of the Jackal and how he became a contract killer.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: With the release of River imminent, UDC believes himself safe on his Croatian island; time is running out, and the Jackal must use all his skills to reach his target…

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: A wanted man, the Jackal is on the run, desperate to get back to Nuria – but Bianca is given one last shot to bring the Jackal to justice.
